adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` from a single object to an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, appends additional hosts’ destination calendars (e.g. `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` in `handleNewBooking.ts`). However, Lark (`packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`) and Office365 (`packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`) now consistently destructure only the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`) to select `externalId` for create/update/delete, and the generic ICS/base provider similarly filters/marks primary using only the first element (`packages/lib/CalendarService.ts`). Unlike GoogleCalendarService, which selects the destination calendar by matching `credentialId` (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), these providers have no per-credential selection. Given `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` loops over all destinations and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` but does not pass `destination.externalId` into provider createEvent, these providers will keep targeting the first destination calendar, leaving other hosts’ calendars unsynced (and potentially creating duplicates on the first calendar).
